exercises.name: Barbell squat
exercises.cues: Brace before each rep. Sit between your hips, keep your feet planted, and use a comfortable depth.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cues: Hold the weight close to your chest. Keep your feet planted and stand tall.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.cues: Use a comfortable stance and depth. Control the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cues: Keep your hips against the pad. Lower within your comfortable range without locking out forcefully.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.cues: Use a stable setup. Lower under control, keep wrists stacked, and use safeties or a spotter.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cues: Keep a stable shoulder position. Use a comfortable elbow angle. Log the load of one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.cues: Keep your trunk braced. Use a raised surface if needed and lower with control.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.cues: Adjust the seat so handles sit around mid-chest. Press through a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.cues: Keep the load close. Hinge at the hips with soft knees; stop before your back position changes.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cues: Push your hips back with a braced trunk. Keep the dumbbells close to your legs.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cues: Press through your feet, raise your hips, and avoid arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Leg curl
exercises.cues: Adjust the pad to your lower legs. Curl smoothly without lifting your hips.

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.cues: Brace your trunk and hold a stable hinge. Pull toward the lower ribs without jerking.

exercises.name: Dumbbell row
exercises.cues: Support your trunk. Pull toward your hip without rotating; log reps per side.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cues: Keep your torso stable. Pull toward your ribs and return under control.

exercises.name: Prone floor pull
exercises.cues: Lie face down, lift your arms gently and draw elbows toward your ribs. This has limited loading potential.

exercises.name: Overhead press
exercises.cues: Brace your trunk. Press overhead through a comfortable range without leaning back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.cues: Keep wrists above elbows. Use a comfortable range and a stable torso.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.cues: Raise your hips and bend your elbows under control. Adjust hand position for comfort.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cues: Pull toward your upper chest, keeping your torso stable. Do not pull behind your neck.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.cues: Start from a comfortable hang. Pull without swinging and lower under control. Log added load only.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.cues: Raise to a comfortable height with soft elbows. Avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.cues: Keep your elbows stable. Curl without swinging; record reps per side.

exercises.name: Cable triceps pushdown
exercises.cues: Keep elbows close to your sides. Extend under control without moving your shoulders.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.cues: Rise onto your toes, pause, and lower with control. Use support for balance.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.cues: Lift your shoulder blades gently and exhale. Avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cues: Use a low incline and stable feet. Lower to a comfortable depth; log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Cable chest fly
exercises.cues: Keep a soft elbow bend. Bring your hands together without rounding or forcing the shoulder range.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
exercises.cues: Keep both feet planted in a split stance. Lower under control and record repetitions per side.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.cues: Use a stable bench and padded bar. Raise the hips while keeping your ribs controlled; avoid overextending.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.cues: Align your knee with the machine pivot. Extend smoothly through a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.cues: Secure the thigh pad and align the knee pivot. Curl under control without lifting your hips.

exercises.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
exercises.cues: Support your chest on a stable incline bench. Pull without lifting your torso; log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Dumbbell rear delt fly
exercises.cues: Hinge with a stable trunk or use chest support. Move through a comfortable arc without swinging.

exercises.name: Cable face pull
exercises.cues: Use a light load and stable stance. Pull toward the face with a comfortable elbow position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hammer curl
exercises.cues: Keep palms facing inward and elbows stable. Curl without rocking your torso; log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Overhead cable triceps extension
exercises.cues: Use a stable stance with elbows in a comfortable position. Extend smoothly without arching your back.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.cues: Place the pad securely above your knees. Raise and lower the heels with control and a comfortable stretch.

exercises.name: Reverse crunch
exercises.cues: Keep the movement small and controlled. Curl the pelvis gently rather than swinging your legs.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
exercises.cues: Keep the hips stable and curl your trunk gently. Avoid pulling only with your arms.

exercises.name: Barbell front squat
exercises.cues: Use a stable front rack and braced trunk. Keep the feet planted and choose a comfortable depth.

exercises.name: Conventional deadlift
exercises.cues: Brace before lifting. Keep the bar close and use a stable setup; lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
exercises.cues: Step back under control. Keep a stable stance and record repetitions per side.

exercises.name: Incline barbell bench press
exercises.cues: Set a low incline, keep a stable upper back and lower under control. Use safeties or a spotter.

exercises.name: Decline barbell bench press
exercises.cues: Secure your legs on a decline bench and use safeties or a spotter. Keep wrists stacked.

exercises.name: Decline dumbbell bench press
exercises.cues: Use a stable decline setup and controlled range. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
exercises.cues: Lower until your upper arms gently meet the floor; avoid bouncing. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Barbell floor press
exercises.cues: Use a safe rack setup and controlled contact of upper arms with the floor.

exercises.name: Smith machine bench press
exercises.cues: Position the bench for a comfortable bar path and set the safety stops before loading.

exercises.name: Smith machine incline bench press
exercises.cues: Use a low incline and position the bench to suit the fixed bar path. Set the safeties.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded chest press
exercises.cues: Adjust the seat for comfortable handles at chest height. Log the total plates added.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded incline chest press
exercises.cues: Keep your back supported and shoulders comfortable. Log the total plates added.

exercises.name: Selectorized incline chest press
exercises.cues: Adjust the seat to the handle path and press without lifting your back. Log the indicated stack load.

exercises.name: Dumbbell chest fly
exercises.cues: Keep a soft elbow bend, use a light load and stop before your shoulder position changes. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell fly
exercises.cues: Use a low incline and a comfortable arc with soft elbows. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Pec deck fly
exercises.cues: Adjust the seat and starting range to keep the shoulders comfortable. Bring the pads together smoothly.

exercises.name: Low-to-high cable fly
exercises.cues: Use low pulleys and a stable stance. Bring the handles up and inward without shrugging.

exercises.name: High-to-low cable fly
exercises.cues: Use high pulleys and draw the handles down and inward with a soft elbow bend.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable chest press
exercises.cues: Use a split stance, resist trunk rotation and press from chest height. Log reps per side.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.cues: Place hands on a stable raised surface. Keep a braced trunk and lower the chest toward your hands.

exercises.name: Decline push-up
exercises.cues: Place feet on a stable low platform and keep your trunk aligned through each repetition.

exercises.name: Kneeling push-up
exercises.cues: Keep shoulders, hips and knees aligned. Lower under control through a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Chest-emphasis dip
exercises.cues: Use stable parallel bars, a slight forward lean and a comfortable depth. Log added load only.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.cues: Use a comfortable underhand grip, avoid swinging and lower under control. Log added load only.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip pull-up
exercises.cues: Use parallel handles and pull without swinging. Log added load only.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip lat pulldown
exercises.cues: Use parallel handles and pull toward the upper chest without leaning far back.

exercises.name: Underhand lat pulldown
exercises.cues: Use a comfortable underhand grip. Keep the torso stable and pull toward the upper chest.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable pulldown
exercises.cues: Keep the trunk stable and guide the elbow toward your side. Record reps per arm.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded lat pulldown
exercises.cues: Set the seat and thigh support securely. Pull through a controlled range and log total plates added.

exercises.name: T-bar row
exercises.cues: Maintain a stable hinge and pull toward the lower ribs without heaving. Log plates added to the lever.

exercises.name: Chest-supported T-bar row
exercises.cues: Keep the chest against the pad throughout the pull. Log total plates added.

exercises.name: Selectorized seated row
exercises.cues: Adjust the chest support and seat. Pull toward the ribs without extending the lower back.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded high row
exercises.cues: Keep the chest supported and guide the elbows down and back. Log total plates added.

exercises.name: Wide-grip cable row
exercises.cues: Use a comfortable wider handle and pull toward the upper abdomen without rocking.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable row
exercises.cues: Resist trunk rotation and guide the elbow back. Record load and repetitions per side.

exercises.name: Underhand barbell row
exercises.cues: Use a comfortable underhand grip and stable hip hinge. Keep the bar close without jerking.

exercises.name: Pendlay row
exercises.cues: Reset the bar on the floor each repetition. Keep the trunk braced and avoid changing torso angle.

exercises.name: Inverted row
exercises.cues: Use a securely fixed bar. Keep the body aligned and pull the chest toward the bar.

exercises.name: Straight-arm cable pulldown
exercises.cues: Keep a soft elbow bend and guide the arms toward the hips without leaning or arching.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
exercises.cues: Support your trunk on a bench, keep ribs controlled and use a comfortable shoulder range. Log the single dumbbell.

exercises.name: Machine pullover
exercises.cues: Adjust the seat and range to keep the shoulders comfortable. Move the upper arms without bouncing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrug
exercises.cues: Raise and lower the shoulders smoothly without rolling them. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Barbell shrug
exercises.cues: Keep the arms straight and lift the shoulders without rolling them or bending the elbows.

exercises.name: Seated barbell overhead press
exercises.cues: Use an upright supported bench and a comfortable grip. Press without overextending your trunk.

exercises.name: Selectorized shoulder press
exercises.cues: Adjust the seat so the handles start at a comfortable shoulder height. Keep your back supported.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded shoulder press
exercises.cues: Use a stable supported setup and comfortable pressing range. Log total plates added.

exercises.name: Smith machine shoulder press
exercises.cues: Position the bench for the fixed bar path and use safety stops. Keep your trunk supported.

exercises.name: Arnold dumbbell press
exercises.cues: Rotate smoothly through a comfortable range without forcing the shoulders. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.cues: Keep the ribs controlled and avoid leaning sideways. Log load and repetitions per arm.

exercises.name: Single-arm kettlebell overhead press
exercises.cues: Begin from a stable rack position, keep the wrist aligned and press without leaning. Log reps per side.

exercises.name: Single-arm landmine press
exercises.cues: Secure the bar in a landmine anchor and press along its arc. Log plates added and reps per side.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable lateral raise
exercises.cues: Raise the arm in a comfortable arc with a soft elbow. Keep the torso still; record reps per side.

exercises.name: Machine lateral raise
exercises.cues: Adjust the seat and arm pads to suit the machine. Raise smoothly without shrugging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell front raise
exercises.cues: Lift to a comfortable height with soft elbows and a stable trunk. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Cable front raise
exercises.cues: Use a low pulley and controlled arc. Avoid leaning back to lift the handle.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.cues: Adjust the seat and move the arms out without arching your trunk. Use a comfortable shoulder range.

exercises.name: Cable rear delt fly
exercises.cues: Keep a soft elbow bend and draw the arms apart without shrugging. Log combined stack load.

exercises.name: Cable shoulder external rotation
exercises.cues: Keep the elbow supported near your side and use light resistance through a comfortable range. Record reps per side.

exercises.name: Barbell curl
exercises.cues: Keep your elbows stable and curl without leaning back.

exercises.name: EZ-bar curl
exercises.cues: Use a comfortable angled grip and a stable trunk. Log bar plus plates.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.cues: Support your back on an incline bench and keep upper arms still. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell preacher curl
exercises.cues: Support the upper arm on the preacher pad and avoid bouncing at the bottom. Record reps per arm.

exercises.name: EZ-bar preacher curl
exercises.cues: Support the upper arms on the pad and use a controlled, comfortable range.

exercises.name: Machine preacher curl
exercises.cues: Align the elbow with the machine pivot. Keep upper arms against the pad.

exercises.name: Cable biceps curl
exercises.cues: Use a low pulley and keep upper arms stable. Curl without leaning back.

exercises.name: Single-arm behind-body cable curl
exercises.cues: Stand ahead of a low pulley and keep the upper arm in a comfortable slightly extended position. Log reps per side.

exercises.name: Cable rope hammer curl
exercises.cues: Use a neutral grip on the rope and keep elbows stable.

exercises.name: Dumbbell concentration curl
exercises.cues: Support the upper arm against the inner thigh and curl without swinging. Log reps per arm.

exercises.name: Dumbbell spider curl
exercises.cues: Support your chest on an incline bench and let the arms hang. Curl without moving the upper arms.

exercises.name: EZ-bar lying triceps extension
exercises.cues: Use a comfortable elbow position and lower under control. Keep the setup secure and log bar plus plates.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lying triceps extension
exercises.cues: Use a comfortable elbow position and controlled lowering. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Two-hand dumbbell overhead extension
exercises.cues: Hold one dumbbell securely with both hands. Keep the ribs controlled and elbows comfortable.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell overhead extension
exercises.cues: Keep the upper arm in a comfortable position. Extend smoothly and record reps per arm.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable triceps kickback
exercises.cues: Hold the upper arm stable behind your torso and extend without swinging. Record reps per side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell triceps kickback
exercises.cues: Support the trunk and keep upper arms still. Extend smoothly; log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Rope triceps pushdown
exercises.cues: Keep upper arms beside the trunk and extend without using body momentum.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable pushdown
exercises.cues: Keep the elbow beside the trunk and use a comfortable handle. Log reps per arm.

exercises.name: Machine triceps extension
exercises.cues: Align the elbow with the machine pivot and keep the upper arm supported.

exercises.name: Close-grip barbell bench press
exercises.cues: Use a comfortable narrower grip with wrists stacked. Set safeties or use a spotter.

exercises.name: Triceps-emphasis dip
exercises.cues: Use stable parallel bars and a relatively upright torso. Stop at a comfortable depth and log added load only.

exercises.name: Close-grip push-up
exercises.cues: Place hands comfortably closer together and keep the trunk braced. Do not force a narrow wrist position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell wrist curl
exercises.cues: Support your forearms and flex the wrists smoothly through a comfortable range. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Barbell wrist curl
exercises.cues: Support the forearms and keep the movement at the wrist. Use a light, controlled load.

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse wrist curl
exercises.cues: Support the forearms with palms down and extend the wrists gently. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Barbell reverse wrist curl
exercises.cues: Support the forearms with palms down and use a light load through a comfortable range.

exercises.name: EZ-bar reverse curl
exercises.cues: Use an overhand grip with straight wrists and stable elbows. Log bar plus plates.

exercises.name: Cable reverse curl
exercises.cues: Use an overhand grip and keep upper arms still. Avoid bending the wrists to finish the curl.

exercises.name: Dumbbell forearm pronation
exercises.cues: Support the forearm and rotate gently toward palm-down with a light implement. Log reps per side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell forearm supination
exercises.cues: Support the forearm and rotate gently toward palm-up with a light implement. Log reps per side.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded hack squat
exercises.cues: Keep the hips and back against the pads. Use a comfortable foot position and depth; log total plates added.

exercises.name: Pendulum squat machine
exercises.cues: Set the safety stop and maintain support against the pad. Use a comfortable depth; log plates added.

exercises.name: Smith machine squat
exercises.cues: Choose a foot position that suits the fixed bar path and set safety stops. Keep the feet planted.

exercises.name: Barbell box squat
exercises.cues: Use a stable box at a suitable height. Touch down under control without rocking backward.

exercises.name: Heel-elevated goblet squat
exercises.cues: Use a stable heel wedge and keep the load close to the chest. Log the single dumbbell.

exercises.name: Kettlebell goblet squat
exercises.cues: Hold one kettlebell close to the chest and squat through a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Double kettlebell front squat
exercises.cues: Keep both kettlebells stable in the front rack and brace before lowering. Log one kettlebell.

exercises.name: Barbell split squat
exercises.cues: Use a stable split stance and safety supports. Lower under control; record repetitions per side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell rear-foot-elevated split squat
exercises.cues: Place the rear foot on a stable low bench and choose a comfortable stance. Record reps per side and one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Bodyweight split squat
exercises.cues: Use a stable split stance and lower vertically through a comfortable range. Record reps per side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell walking lunge
exercises.cues: Step forward under control and use a clear path. Record repetitions per side and one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Bodyweight forward lunge
exercises.cues: Step forward with control, then push back to standing. Record repetitions per side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral lunge
exercises.cues: Step sideways and sit into the working hip while the other leg lengthens. Log one dumbbell held at the chest and reps per side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell step-up
exercises.cues: Use a stable box and drive through the leading leg without jumping from the trailing foot. Record reps per side.

exercises.name: Bodyweight step-up
exercises.cues: Choose a stable step at a manageable height and lower under control. Record reps per side.

exercises.name: Single-leg press
exercises.cues: Keep hips against the pad and use a controlled comfortable range. Record load and reps per leg.

exercises.name: Single-leg extension
exercises.cues: Align the knee with the pivot and extend without lifting the hip. Record load and reps per side.

exercises.name: Belt squat machine
exercises.cues: Fit the belt securely and keep the feet planted through a comfortable range. Log plates added.

exercises.name: Barbell stiff-leg deadlift
exercises.cues: Keep a slight knee bend and hinge without rounding the trunk. Stop at your controlled range.

exercises.name: Single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cues: Use a stable single-leg hinge and level hips. Log one dumbbell and reps per side.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cues: Hold one kettlebell close to the legs and push the hips back with soft knees.

exercises.name: Smith machine Romanian deadlift
exercises.cues: Choose a stance suited to the fixed path and hinge with the bar close. Set safety stops.

exercises.name: Barbell good morning
exercises.cues: Use a light load, a braced trunk and soft knees. Hinge only within a controlled range.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
exercises.cues: Align knees with the machine pivot and keep hips against the pad. Curl without bouncing.

exercises.name: Standing single-leg curl
exercises.cues: Align the knee pivot and keep the pelvis stable. Log load and reps per side.

exercises.name: Standing cable leg curl
exercises.cues: Attach an ankle cuff securely and hold support. Curl the heel back without moving the thigh; log reps per side.

exercises.name: Nordic hamstring curl
exercises.cues: Secure the ankles with an appropriate partner or fixture. Keep hips extended and use hand support as needed.

exercises.name: Sliding leg curl
exercises.cues: Use sliders on a suitable surface. Keep the hips lifted while drawing the heels in and extending under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
exercises.cues: Support the upper back on a stable bench and pad one dumbbell over the hips. Keep ribs controlled.

exercises.name: Smith machine hip thrust
exercises.cues: Use a stable bench, padded bar and safety stops. Extend the hips without arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded hip thrust
exercises.cues: Fit the pad or belt securely and follow the machine setup. Extend the hips smoothly; log plates added.

exercises.name: Barbell glute bridge
exercises.cues: Pad the bar and keep the upper back on the floor. Raise the hips without overextending the trunk.

exercises.name: Single-leg glute bridge
exercises.cues: Keep the pelvis level and drive through the planted foot. Log repetitions per side.

exercises.name: Cable glute kickback
exercises.cues: Use a secure ankle cuff and stable support. Move from the hip without arching your trunk; record reps per side.

exercises.name: Cable pull-through
exercises.cues: Face away from a low pulley and hinge at the hips with a braced trunk.

exercises.name: Seated hip abduction machine
exercises.cues: Adjust the pads and seat, then open the thighs through a controlled range without bouncing.

exercises.name: Standing cable hip abduction
exercises.cues: Hold stable support and move the cuffed leg sideways without tilting the pelvis. Log reps per side.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip abduction
exercises.cues: Keep hips stacked and raise the upper leg without rolling backward. Record reps per side.

exercises.name: Trap-bar deadlift
exercises.cues: Stand centered inside the bar, brace and push through the feet. Log bar plus plates and note handle height.

exercises.name: Sumo deadlift
exercises.cues: Choose a comfortable wide stance, brace and keep the bar close. Avoid forcing hip positions.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
exercises.cues: Set one kettlebell between the feet and stand with a controlled hip and knee drive.

exercises.name: Two-hand kettlebell swing
exercises.cues: Use a hip hinge to drive the bell to about chest height. Keep the arms relaxed and stop before technique changes.

exercises.name: Hip extension on 45-degree bench
exercises.cues: Set the pad below the hips. Hinge at the hips with a braced trunk and stop at a straight body line.

exercises.name: Supported lumbar extension machine
exercises.cues: Secure the pelvis as the machine instructs and move slowly through a comfortable supported spinal range. Avoid forceful end-range extension.

exercises.name: Seated hip adduction machine
exercises.cues: Adjust the starting width to a comfortable range. Bring the thighs together without bouncing.

exercises.name: Standing cable hip adduction
exercises.cues: Hold stable support and draw the cuffed leg inward without rotating the pelvis. Record reps per side.

exercises.name: Side-lying hip adduction
exercises.cues: Support the upper leg and raise the lower leg gently while keeping hips stacked. Log reps per side.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise machine
exercises.cues: Keep knees comfortably extended and move the heels through a controlled range without bouncing.

exercises.name: Smith machine calf raise
exercises.cues: Use a secure platform and safety stops. Raise and lower the heels slowly with stable knees.

exercises.name: Leg press calf raise
exercises.cues: Use a secure foot position on the platform and keep knees stable. Move the ankles without locking the knees forcefully.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.cues: Use support for balance and move slowly through a comfortable ankle range. Record reps per leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell standing calf raise
exercises.cues: Hold two dumbbells at the sides and raise the heels under control. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Dumbbell seated calf raise
exercises.cues: Place one padded dumbbell securely over each thigh and lift the heels smoothly. Log one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded seated calf raise
exercises.cues: Secure the thigh pad above the knees and lower the heels under control. Log plates added.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
exercises.cues: Begin from a comfortable hang and curl the pelvis as the knees rise. Avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.cues: Keep the hang stable and raise the legs only as far as you can control the pelvis. Avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Captain’s chair knee raise
exercises.cues: Support the forearms securely and curl the pelvis as the knees rise. Keep the movement controlled.

exercises.name: Decline bench crunch
exercises.cues: Secure the legs and curl the shoulder blades upward without pulling on the neck.

exercises.name: Machine abdominal crunch
exercises.cues: Adjust the seat and pads and curl the trunk gently without pulling only with the arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell weighted crunch
exercises.cues: Hold one light dumbbell securely at the chest and curl the shoulder blades gently off the floor.

exercises.name: Kneeling ab wheel rollout
exercises.cues: Use an ab wheel from the knees, brace and roll only as far as you can return without arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cues: Move the opposite arm and leg slowly while keeping the trunk stable. Log repetitions per side.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cues: From hands and knees, reach the opposite arm and leg without rotating or arching. Log repetitions per side.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof press
exercises.cues: Stand side-on to a secure chest-height pulley. Press the handle out without rotating and return; log repetitions per side.

exercises.name: High-to-low cable wood chop
exercises.cues: Use a light load and controlled rotation through the trunk and hips. Avoid twisting sharply; log reps per side.

exercises.name: Low-to-high cable lift
exercises.cues: Use a low pulley and turn smoothly through the hips and trunk. Record repetitions per side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell side bend
exercises.cues: Hold one dumbbell and use a small, controlled side bend without rotating. Record reps per side.

exercises.name: Side plank hip lift
exercises.cues: From a supported side plank, lower and raise the hips through a small controlled range. Log repetitions per side.

exercises.name: Plank shoulder tap
exercises.cues: From a stable high plank, tap the opposite shoulder without rocking. Record taps per side.
